mil7.2.10:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, makaṭassa dve angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.2.10:1.2: Yathā mahārāja makkaṭo vāsam-upagacchanto tathārūpe okāse mahatimahārukkhe pavivitte sabbaṭṭhakasākhe bhīruttāṇe vāsam-upagacchati,
mil7.2.10:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena lajjiṃ pesalaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ piyaṃ garuṃ bhāvaniyaṃ vattāraṃ vacanakkhamaṃ ovādakaṃ viññāpakaṃ sandassakaṃ samādapakaṃ samuttejakaṃ sampahaṃsakaṃ, evarūpaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ ācariyaṃ upanissāya viharitabbaṃ.
mil7.2.10:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja makkaṭassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.2.10:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja makkaṭo rukkhe yeva carati tiṭṭhati nisīdati, yadi middhaṃ okkamati tatth' eva rattiṃ vāsam-anubhavati,
mil7.2.10:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena pavanābhimukhena bhavitabbaṃ, pavane yeva ṭhānacankama-nisajja-sayanaṃ niddaṃ okkamitabbaṃ, tatth' eva satipaṭṭhānam-anubhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.2.10:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja makkaṭassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.2.10:2.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā:
